messages:
Sam (Billing Ops): Heads-up: Aurelia Labs (UK) dispute — they were charged the full new Dedicated monthly fee when they upgraded mid-cycle and never got a proration credit for the Standard subscription. Requesting manual credit + small goodwill.
Maya (Account Exec): Confirmed. Customer upgraded 2026-05-12 (mid-billing cycle). Our system created the new dedicated invoice but failed to apply the pro-rata credit for the remaining days of the old plan. They're out ~£1,120 on the bill and asking for correction + £50 goodwill for the trouble.
Sam (Billing Ops): Pulled invoice lines:
```
Invoice: 11820
Customer: Aurelia Labs (UK)
Period: 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31
Line: Dedicated Pool (full month)    £2,400.00
Line: Standard Plan (full month)     £1,280.00  <-- should have been credited prorata from 5/12
Adjustments: none
Total: £3,680.00
```
Maya (Account Exec): Expected credit calc from AM: Standard plan monthly £1,280. Upgrade effective 2026-05-12 => days unused 20 of 31 => credit = 20/31 * 1280 = £825.81. So net correction = £825.81 credited + goodwill £50 = £875.81 to be applied as CM. Customer requested net refund of £875.81.
Sam (Billing Ops): billing-bot, draft credit memo for £875.81 tag aurelia-upgrade-2026 and reason "pro-rata old plan credit + goodwill". Attach calc sheet when ready.
billing-bot: Draft created  CM-2026-622 for £875.81 (status: DRAFT). Attachments: none.
Priya (Head of Billing): Need to confirm VAT treatment for UK. tax-bot, is the credit VATable? Also we round to two decimals in GBP; keep precision consistent.
tax-bot: Refund/credit adjusting taxable supply in UK: apply VAT reversal at customer's place of supply. Aurelia is UK VAT-registered? Pulling customer tax profile... Customer VAT id: GB245678901. VAT-registered B2B, so reverse-charge applies; credit memo net = £725.67 (calc: 875.81 / 1.208) VAT adjustment = £150.14. Record net/gross per AP.
Priya (Head of Billing): Approve up to £1k for these upgrade corrections. Sam  upload AM calc and customer's upgrade confirmation email to CM record and mark tax handling in memo.
Maya (Account Exec): Uploaded: aurelia_upgrade_20260512.eml, calc_CM_11820.xlsx. Customer confirmed in email they accepted prorata correction and goodwill.
Sam (Billing Ops): billing-bot, move CM-2026-622 to PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya).
billing-bot: CM-2026-622 status -> PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya).
Priya (Head of Billing): Approved. Add internal memo: "Approved per upgrade policy section 4.1; AM confirmed upgrade email 2026-05-12." Priya added memo.
Sam (Billing Ops): billing-bot, finalize and apply CM-2026-622 to Invoice 11820. Post GL entries and notify Treasury for currency settlement.
billing-bot: CM-2026-622 moved to APPROVED and applied to Invoice 11820. New invoice balance: £2,804.19. Journal: CRD-2026-622 posted. RevOps notified for revenue impact. Treasury team tagged for GBP settlement.
treasury-team: Noted for settlement and bank reconciliation. Will flag any cash movement in FX batch. Also confirm we do not issue a separate refund (customer asked for account credit). If they request payout, we need payment run approval.
Maya (Account Exec): Customer replied: "Thanks for sorting this fast — the account credit is fine." :relieved:
Sam (Billing Ops): Closing thread after attaching CM paperwork to May month-end pack. Thanks all :thumbsup:
